literal: Offenders are to be judged for violating regulations."
idiomatic: Offenders are to be judged for violating regulations."

literal: Sixth month, day jichou: the court visited the Deer Wild Park.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the jichou day, the court visited the Deer Wild Park.

literal: On the gengzi day, the imperial uncle Ruo died.
idiomatic: On the gengzi day the imperial uncle Ruo died.

literal: Seventh month of autumn, day wuchen: the state of Kucha sent envoys presenting seventy famous camels.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the wuchen day, the state of Kucha sent envoys presenting seventy famous camels.

literal: Liu Zhun sent generals to raid Chouchi; Yang Guangxiang, administrator of Yinping, drove them off.
idiomatic: Liu Zhun sent generals to raid Chouchi; Yang Guangxiang, administrator of Yinping, drove them off.

literal: Eighth month: envoys were dispatched separately to investigate governors and magistrates and inquire into the people's hardships.
idiomatic: In the eighth month envoys were dispatched separately to investigate governors and magistrates and inquire into the people's hardships.

literal: On the bingxu day, an edict abolished tribute of birds and beasts from all provinces.
idiomatic: On the bingxu day an edict abolished tribute of birds and beasts from all provinces.

literal: On the dinghai day, the state of Mohe sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the dinghai day the state of Mohe sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Ninth month, day bingchen: a partial amnesty in the capital.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the bingchen day, a partial amnesty was proclaimed in the capital.

literal: The state of Kucha sent envoys presenting great horses, famous camels, and many treasures.
idiomatic: The state of Kucha sent envoys presenting great horses, famous camels, and many treasures.

literal: Tenth month of winter, day renchen: an edict that Acting Palace Attendant of Scattered Cavalry Zheng Xi was envoy to Liu Zhun.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the renchen day, an edict named Zheng Xi, acting palace attendant of scattered cavalry, envoy to Liu Zhun.

literal: Eleventh month, day gengxu: an edict said: "When ranks are suspended at court, those with merit must be bound to reward;
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the gengxu day, an edict said, "When ranks are suspended at court, those with merit must be bound to reward;

literal: when punishments are suspended in the market, those with guilt must suffer their penalty.
idiomatic: when punishments are suspended in the market, those with guilt must suffer their penalty.

literal: This is the settled canon of ancient and modern times and the solid essentials of the way of rule.
idiomatic: This is the settled canon of ancient and modern times and the solid essentials of the way of rule.

literal: The provincial inspectors are officials who pasture the people; recently they have each been remiss and lax, indulging wrongdoing and taking bribes, turning their backs on the public and seeking private gain, so that bandits and robbers arise together and raids and plunder are extreme; reports of treachery repeatedly reach Our ears.
idiomatic: The provincial inspectors are officials who pasture the people; recently they have each been remiss and lax, indulging wrongdoing and taking bribes, turning their backs on the public and seeking private gain, so that bandits and robbers arise together and raids and plunder are extreme; reports of treachery repeatedly reach our ears.

literal: We inherit the fortune of peace and belong to the term of a thousand years, thinking to enlarge the great line and renew the myriad achievements;
idiomatic: We inherit the fortune of peace and belong to the term of a thousand years, thinking to enlarge the great line and renew the myriad achievements;

literal: We also look to the feudal ministers and assembled offices to spread virtue and proclaim grace and together assist Our immaturity in completing this excellence.
idiomatic: We also look to the feudal ministers and assembled offices to spread virtue and proclaim grace and together assist our immaturity in completing this excellence.

literal: May you restrain yourselves and return to ritual, think on faults and reform errors, so that Our dullness is not shamed before the ancestors and the people see virtue in the present age.
idiomatic: May you restrain yourselves and return to ritual, think on faults and reform errors, so that our dullness is not shamed before the ancestors and the people see virtue in the present age.

literal: The offices are clearly to set forth prohibitions by article, as Our mind intends."
idiomatic: The offices are clearly to set forth prohibitions by article, as our mind intends."

literal: Twelfth month, day guisi: Prince of Nan commandery Li Hui was executed.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the guisi day, Li Hui, Prince of Nan commandery, was executed.

literal: That year more than twenty provinces and garrisons suffered flood and drought; the people were hungry and granaries were opened for relief.
idiomatic: That year more than twenty provinces and garrisons suffered flood and drought; the people were hungry and granaries were opened for relief.

literal: Third year, spring, first month, day guichou: the Kunde Six Harmonies Hall was completed.
idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the third year, on the guichou day, the Kunde Six Harmonies Hall was completed.

literal: On the gengshen day, an edict abolished touring inspection officials.
idiomatic: On the gengshen day an edict abolished touring inspection officials.

literal: Second month, day xinsi: the Emperor and Grand Empress Dowager visited the hot springs of Dai commandery, inquired into the people's hardships, and gave palace women as wives to widowers and the poor.
idiomatic: In the second month, on the xinsi day, the emperor and grand empress dowager visited the hot springs of Dai commandery, inquired into the people's hardships, and gave palace women as wives to widowers and the poor.

literal: On the jihai day, returned to the palace.
idiomatic: On the jihai day the court returned to the palace.

literal: On the renyin day, the Qianxiang Six Harmonies Hall was completed.
idiomatic: On the renyin day the Qianxiang Six Harmonies Hall was completed.

literal: [9] Third month, day jiachen: a partial amnesty in the capital.
idiomatic: [9] In the third month, on the jiachen day, a partial amnesty was proclaimed in the capital.

literal: On the wuwu day, Tuyuhun and Goryeo each sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the wuwu day Tuyuhun and Goryeo each sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Summer, fourth month, day renshen: Liu Zhun sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the renshen day, Liu Zhun sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On the guiwei day, Prince of Lele Yueping died.
idiomatic: On the guiwei day Prince of Lele Yueping died.

literal: On the xinmao day, the Rouran state sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the xinmao day the Rouran state sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On the bingshen day, the court visited Mount Guo.
idiomatic: On the bingshen day the court visited Mount Guo.

literal: On the jihai day, returned to the palace.
idiomatic: On the jihai day the court returned to the palace.

literal: On the gengzi day, Wei Yuan, Duke of Huaiyang, was advanced to prince.
idiomatic: On the gengzi day Wei Yuan, Duke of Huaiyang, was advanced to prince.

literal: The state of Tuyuhun sent envoys presenting fifty yak.
idiomatic: The state of Tuyuhun sent envoys presenting fifty yak.

literal: Muchin, inspector of Yong province and Prince of Yidu, was guilty and sentenced to death.
idiomatic: Muchin, inspector of Yong province and Prince of Yidu, was guilty and sentenced to death.

literal: Fifth month, day dingsi: the Emperor prayed for rain in the northern park and closed Yang Gate; that day timely rain fell abundantly.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the dingsi day, the emperor prayed for rain in the northern park and closed Yang Gate; that day timely rain fell abundantly.

literal: On the xinyou day, an edict said: "In past ages the four dynasties nourished the aged and sought counsel, begging for words.
idiomatic: On the xinyou day an edict said, "In past ages the four dynasties nourished the aged and sought counsel, begging for words.

literal: Though We are immature, We always honor this excellence.
idiomatic: Though we are immature, we always honor this excellence.

literal: Now bestow on each national elder one suit of clothing, five jin of cotton, and five bolts each of silk and cloth."
idiomatic: Now bestow on each national elder one suit of clothing, five jin of cotton, and five bolts each of silk and cloth."

literal: Sixth month, day xinwei: because the people of Yong province were hungry, granaries were opened for relief.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the xinwei day, because the people of Yong province were hungry, granaries were opened for relief.

literal: The Wenshi Chamber and Lingquan Hall were begun on Mount Fang.
idiomatic: The Wenshi Chamber and Lingquan Hall were begun on Mount Fang.

literal: Tenth month of winter, day jisi new moon: a general amnesty throughout the realm.
idiomatic: On the new moon of the tenth month of winter, on the jisi day, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

literal: Eleventh month, day guimao: the poor, aged, and sick in the capital who could not support themselves were given clothing and cloth in differing amounts.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the guimao day, the poor, aged, and sick in the capital who could not support themselves were given clothing and cloth in differing amounts.

literal: On the guichou day, Acting Prince of Liang commandery Yuan Jia was advanced to acting prince and ordered to command two generals out from Huaiyin;
idiomatic: On the guichou day Yuan Jia, acting Prince of Liang commandery, was advanced to acting prince and ordered to command two generals out from Huaiyin;

literal: Yuan Chen of Longxi with three generals out from Guangling;
idiomatic: Yuan Chen of Longxi with three generals out from Guangling;

literal: Xue Huzi of Hedong with three generals out from Shouchun.
idiomatic: Xue Huzi of Hedong with three generals out from Shouchun.

literal: The Rouran led more than a hundred thousand horse south to raid; they reached the frontier and returned.
idiomatic: The Rouran led more than a hundred thousand horse south to raid; they reached the frontier and returned.

literal: Twelfth month: Sogdiana, Zhouyi, Hegong, Diefuluo, Yuan Kuo, Sivanjin, and other states each sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month Sogdiana, Zhouyi, Hegong, Diefuluo, Yuan Kuo, Sivanjin, and other states each sent envoys with tribute.

literal: That year the island barbarian Xiao Daocheng deposed his lord Liu Zhun and usurped the throne, styling himself Qi.
idiomatic: That year the island barbarian Xiao Daocheng deposed his lord Liu Zhun and usurped the throne, styling himself Qi.

literal: Fourth month, day jimao, [10] the court visited the Ministry of Justice and Registry prisons and summoned the prisoners.
idiomatic: In the fourth month, on the jimao day, [10] the court visited the Ministry of Justice and Registry prisons and summoned the prisoners.

literal: An edict said: "The Ministry of Justice is the balance of the realm; the people's lives hang upon it.
idiomatic: An edict said, "The Ministry of Justice is the balance of the realm; the people's lives hang upon it.

literal: That We may show pity in punishment depends on the prison officials fitting their charge.
idiomatic: That we may show pity in punishment depends on the prison officials fitting their charge.

literal: If one man does not plow, others may suffer his hunger;
idiomatic: If one man does not plow, others may suffer his hunger;

literal: if one woman does not weave, others may suffer her cold.
idiomatic: if one woman does not weave, others may suffer her cold.

literal: Now it is the crucial month of farming, the autumn when the people exert their strength, yet foolish people who fall into crime are very numerous.
idiomatic: Now it is the crucial month of farming, the autumn when the people exert their strength, yet foolish people who fall into crime are very numerous.

literal: Dispose according to lightness and heaviness and send them to farming work."
idiomatic: Dispose according to lightness and heaviness and send them to farming work."

literal: On the xinsi day, the court visited Mount Baideng.
idiomatic: On the xinsi day the court visited Mount Baideng.

literal: On the jiashen day, households in the realm without miscellaneous property were given one year's grain from the granary.
idiomatic: On the jiashen day households in the realm without miscellaneous property were given one year's grain from the granary.

literal: Fifth month, day bingshen new moon: the court visited Mount Huo.
idiomatic: On the new moon of the fifth month, on the bingshen day, the court visited Mount Huo.

literal: On the renyin day, returned to the palace.
idiomatic: On the renyin day the court returned to the palace.

literal: Sixth month, day dingmao: because timely rain had fallen abundantly, a partial amnesty in the capital.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the dingmao day, because timely rain had fallen abundantly, a partial amnesty was proclaimed in the capital.

literal: A million bolts of silk, damask, thin silk, and cloth and captives from the southern campaign were bestowed on princes and dukes and below.
idiomatic: A million bolts of silk, damask, thin silk, and cloth and captives from the southern campaign were bestowed on princes and dukes and below.

literal: Seventh month of autumn, day xinhai: the court traveled to Mount Huo.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the xinhai day, the court traveled to Mount Huo.

literal: On the renzi day, the Dongming Observatory was rebuilt.
idiomatic: On the renzi day the Dongming Observatory was rebuilt.

literal: An edict assembled the capital's elders and bestowed brocade, clothing, armrests, staffs, rice, honey, and flour; their households were exempted from corvée.
idiomatic: An edict assembled the capital's elders and bestowed brocade, clothing, armrests, staffs, rice, honey, and flour; their households were exempted from corvée.

literal: The state of Sogdiana sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: The state of Sogdiana sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Intercalary month, day dinghai: the court visited the tiger park and personally recorded prisoners; the light cases were all pardoned.
idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the dinghai day, the court visited the tiger park and personally recorded prisoners; the light cases were all pardoned.

literal: On the renchen day, Li Zhongkui, Prince of Dunqiu, was guilty and sentenced to death.
idiomatic: On the renchen day Li Zhongkui, Prince of Dunqiu, was guilty and sentenced to death.

literal: The garrison commander of Jiaocheng in Xiao Daocheng's realm asked to submit the city inward.
idiomatic: The garrison commander of Jiaocheng in Xiao Daocheng's realm asked to submit the city inward.

literal: Eighth month, day dingyou: an edict that Jia, inspector of Xuzhou and Acting Prince of Liang commandery, was to go to receive them.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the dingyou day, an edict ordered Jia, inspector of Xuzhou and acting Prince of Liang commandery, to go to receive them.

literal: Also dispatched General Who Pacifies the South Lang Datan with three generals out from Ju city; General Bai Tutou with two generals out from Haixi; General Yuan Tai with two generals out from Lian mouth; General Feng Pi with three generals out from Jiaocheng; [11] General Who Guards the South Heluo out from Xia cai.
idiomatic: Also dispatched Lang Datan, General Who Pacifies the South, with three generals out from Ju city; Bai Tutou with two generals out from Haixi; Yuan Tai with two generals out from Lian mouth; Feng Pi with three generals out from Jiaocheng; [11] and Heluo, General Who Guards the South, out from Xia cai.

literal: On the jiachen day, the court visited Mount Fang.
idiomatic: On the jiachen day the court visited Mount Fang.

literal: On the wushen day, the court visited the cave temple at Mount Wuzhou.
idiomatic: On the wushen day the court visited the cave temple at Mount Wuzhou.

literal: On the gengxu day, returned to the palace.
idiomatic: On the gengxu day the court returned to the palace.

literal: On the yimao day, an edict that all provinces establish ice houses.
idiomatic: On the yimao day an edict ordered all provinces to establish ice houses.

literal: Cui Huijing, governor of Liang province in Xiao Daocheng's realm, sent Chief Clerk Pei Shubao leading troops to raid Wuxing; Yang Shu, Di chief of Guancheng, defeated them and Shubao returned to Nanzheng.
idiomatic: Cui Huijing, governor of Liang province in Xiao Daocheng's realm, sent Chief Clerk Pei Shubao leading troops to raid Wuxing; Yang Shu, Di chief of Guancheng, defeated them and Shubao returned to Nanzheng.

literal: Ninth month: Chang Yuanzhen, administrator of Runan in Xiao Daocheng's realm, and Flying Dragon General Hu Qinggou led their households inward.
idiomatic: In the ninth month Chang Yuanzhen, administrator of Runan in Xiao Daocheng's realm, and Flying Dragon General Hu Qinggou led their households inward.

literal: On the yihai day, the Siyi Hall was completed.
idiomatic: On the yihai day the Siyi Hall was completed.

literal: On the renwu day, the Dongming Observatory was completed.
idiomatic: On the renwu day the Dongming Observatory was completed.

literal: On the wuzi day, an edict said: "Severe cold and snow fall; those in fetters and those in transport at the capital may suffer cold and hunger—We are moved for them.
idiomatic: On the wuzi day an edict said, "Severe cold and snow fall; those in fetters and those in transport at the capital may suffer cold and hunger—we are moved for them.

literal: Dispatch attendant ministers to the Ministry of Justice prison and places with prisoners to tour and inspect; give food and clothing to the hungry and cold, and replace heavy shackles with light bonds."
idiomatic: Dispatch attendant ministers to the Ministry of Justice prison and places with prisoners to tour and inspect; give food and clothing to the hungry and cold, and replace heavy shackles with light bonds."

literal: Acting Prince of Liang commandery Jia defeated Xiao Daocheng's generals Lu Shaozhi and Xuan Yuandu at Ju Mountain; the garrison chief at Xia cai abandoned the city and fled.
idiomatic: Jia, acting Prince of Liang commandery, defeated Xiao Daocheng's generals Lu Shaozhi and Xuan Yuandu at Ju Mountain; the garrison chief at Xia cai abandoned the city and fled.

literal: Tenth month of winter, day dingwei: an edict that Feng Xi, Prince of Changli, was western-route commander and, with General Who Campaigns South Huan Dan, advanced from Yiyang;
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the dingwei day, an edict made Feng Xi, Prince of Changli, western-route commander and, with Huan Dan, General Who Campaigns South, advanced from Yiyang;

literal: General Who Guards the South Heluo advanced east from Xia cai toward Zhongli.
idiomatic: Heluo, General Who Guards the South, advanced east from Xia cai toward Zhongli.

literal: Huan Fu of Lanling killed his county magistrate and, with Huan He of Changyu and the Taishan bandit Zhang Heyan and others, [12] gathered a band and held Wugu, making Sima Langzhi their leader.
idiomatic: Huan Fu of Lanling killed his county magistrate and, with Huan He of Changyu and the Taishan bandit Zhang Heyan and others, [12] gathered a band and held Wugu, making Sima Langzhi their leader.

literal: An edict that Wei Yuan, Prince of Huaiyang, and others were to campaign against them.
idiomatic: An edict ordered Wei Yuan, Prince of Huaiyang, and others to campaign against them.

literal: That year an edict that in eighteen provinces and garrisons that suffered flood and drought, the people were hungry and granaries were opened for relief.
idiomatic: That year an edict ordered granaries opened for relief in eighteen provinces and garrisons that suffered flood and drought, where the people were hungry.

literal: Fifth year, spring, first month, day jimao: the imperial carriage toured south.
idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the fifth year, on the jimao day, the imperial carriage toured south.

literal: On the dinghai day, reached Zhongshan.
idiomatic: On the dinghai day the court reached Zhongshan.

literal: Personally saw the aged and inquired into the people's hardships.
idiomatic: The emperor personally saw the aged and inquired into the people's hardships.

literal: Second month, day xinmao new moon: a general amnesty throughout the realm.
idiomatic: On the new moon of the second month, on the xinmao day, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

literal: Grain and cloth in differing amounts were bestowed on the filial, fraternal, and diligent in farming, and the orphaned and poor who could not support themselves;
idiomatic: Grain and cloth in differing amounts were bestowed on the filial, fraternal, and diligent in farming, and the orphaned and poor who could not support themselves;

literal: aged palace women were released to their kin.
idiomatic: aged palace women were released to their kin.

literal: On the dingyou day, the imperial carriage visited Xindu and inquired as at Zhongshan.
idiomatic: On the dingyou day the imperial carriage visited Xindu and inquired as at Zhongshan.

literal: On the guimao day, returned to Zhongshan.
idiomatic: On the guimao day the court returned to Zhongshan.

literal: On the jiyou day, martial review on the south bank of the Tang River.
idiomatic: On the jiyou day martial review was held on the south bank of the Tang River.

literal: On the gengxu day, the imperial carriage returned to the capital.
idiomatic: On the gengxu day the imperial carriage returned to the capital.

literal: The monk Faxiu plotted rebellion and was executed.
idiomatic: The monk Faxiu plotted rebellion and was executed.

literal: The southern campaign generals defeated Xiao Daocheng's mobile general Huan Kang at Huaiyang.
idiomatic: The southern campaign generals defeated Huan Kang, Xiao Daocheng's mobile general, at Huaiyang.
